content:
Maria Hernandez: noticed negative per-call cost on console for tenant acme-inc during warmup. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/warmup-flag.png
Dave Kim: likely double-applied prefetch credits (ingest + UI). sample row: invocation_id=inv-1805 tenant=acme-inc tokens_total=500 tokens_cached=450 cache_credits_assigned=12 prefetch_amort_window=800
Joanne Patel: agree. propose adding telemetry fields `prefetch_credit_origin` and `prefetch_credit_bucket` so UI can be authoritative and skip client-side sampling when origin=="ingest".
Dave Kim: add a readonly endpoint `/econ/preview?tenant=...&prefetch_id=...` that returns the first 50 amortized steps, server-side TTL cache keyed by (tenant,prefetch_id). UI fetches on-demand via a "show amortization" link.
Maria Hernandez: UX/support ask: keep default hover summary concise; only fetch full preview when a user requests it. I'll draft a short blurb to explain transient negative rows.
ops-bot: deploy queued: econometrics-ingest v3.5 -> staging at 1805000100 by @joanne :rocket:
Joanne Patel: I'll implement telemetry fields + feature flag `econ_ui_sampling_v2=false` and include migration notes. PR when ready.
Dave Kim: I'll add preview endpoint + caching + a regression test for negative unit-cost spikes.
Maria Hernandez: action items clear. target: patch to staging in 48h and monitor econ dashboards. cc @product for visibility. :thumbsup:
